name: Tourist / Visa-Exempt Entry

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of over 100 countries (most of the Americas and Western countries) may enter Panama visa-free for up to 3 months.

requirement_groups.name: Holders of a valid Canada/US/Australia/South Korea/Japan/UK/Singapore/EU visa

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals who are not otherwise visa-exempt, but hold a valid visa from Canada, the US, Australia, South Korea, Japan, the UK, Singapore, or an EU country, may enter visa-free for up to 30 days, subject to proof of economic solvency of at least USD 500 (Decreto Ejecutivo No. 521).

evidence_required.document: Proof of economic solvency (USD 500 minimum, for the visa-exemption-stamp group)

outcome.duration_length: up to 30 or 90 days depending on group

sources.title: Embassy of Panama -- Visa categories: visa-exempt nationalities (90 days), visa-exemption stamp for designated-visa holders (30 days, USD 500 solvency)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Panama's initial build. Panama also has 'Authorized Visa' (up to 60 business days processing, African/Middle Eastern/South Asian nationals) and 'Stamped Visa' (faster, for Cuba/Dominican Republic/Philippines/Venezuela and others) categories confirmed at tier-1 -- not modelled as separate route files here since they are visa-required variants of the same visit purpose rather than distinct legal statuses, but flagged for completeness.
